findings.issue: Explanation of the target grammar says to 'join ても/ては' before ならない. ても is wrong here: なくても pairs with いい/かまわない (permission), and なくてもならない is ungrammatical. Only ては belongs in なくてはならない. Teaches a false variant of the obligation pattern.
findings.current: join ても/ては and close with ならない ('does not become acceptable')
findings.suggested: join ては and close with ならない ('does not become acceptable')

findings.issue: Same defect as expl_en: 'junta-se ても/ては' offers ても as an alternative in なくてはならない. なくてもならない is ungrammatical (なくても goes with いい). Only ては is correct in this obligation pattern.
findings.current: junta-se ても/ては e fecha-se com ならない ('não se torna aceitável')
findings.suggested: junta-se ては e fecha-se com ならない ('não se torna aceitável')

findings.issue: ネクタイを締める is the standard collocation for putting on/knotting a tie while dressing (…and then going out). 'Tightens his tie' describes adjusting an already-worn tie — wrong sense in this context.
findings.current: He tightens his tie and leaves the house.
findings.suggested: He puts on his tie and leaves the house.

findings.issue: 'Aperta a gravata' means squeezing/tightening an already-worn tie. ネクタイを締めて出かける means putting on (knotting) the tie before going out. Sense-shifting rendering of the sentence's target verb.
findings.current: Ele aperta a gravata e sai de casa.
findings.suggested: Ele coloca a gravata e sai de casa.

findings.issue: The explanation teaches the wrong contextual sense of the target verb: 締める with ネクタイ means 'to put on/knot (a tie)', not 'to tighten/adjust'. Also affects the earlier phrase "links 'to tighten the tie' to 'to go out'".
findings.current: The target here is the verb 締める ('to tighten/adjust') applied to a tie
findings.suggested: The target here is the verb 締める ('to put on/knot', of neckwear) applied to a tie

findings.issue: Mesma falha da expl_en: ensina o sentido errado do verbo-alvo. ネクタイを締める = 'colocar/dar o nó na gravata', não 'apertar/ajustar'. Também afeta o trecho "liga 'apertar a gravata' a 'sair'".
findings.current: O alvo aqui é o verbo 締める ('apertar/ajustar') aplicado a uma gravata
findings.suggested: O alvo aqui é o verbo 締める ('colocar/dar o nó em') aplicado a uma gravata

findings.issue: Token gloss for 締め fits the 'tighten (screw/belt)' sense, not the tie-collocation sense used in this sentence ('put on/knot a tie').
findings.current: to tighten, to adjust (the tie)
findings.suggested: to put on, to knot (a tie)

findings.issue: Glossa do token 締め com sentido errado no contexto: com ネクタイ significa 'colocar/dar o nó na gravata', não 'apertar/ajustar'.
findings.current: apertar, ajustar (a gravata)
findings.suggested: colocar, dar o nó (na gravata)

findings.issue: ビールを is a を-marked direct object, but the literal mirror renders it with the topic device 'As for beer', misrepresenting を as は. The batch's own convention mirrors objects as [obj] (cf. sent:gen-02ced56fb9b2, sent:gen-0280d5448cff).
findings.current: As for beer, how many glasses did you drink?
findings.suggested: Beer [obj], how many glasses did (you) drink?

findings.issue: ビールを é objeto direto marcado por を, mas o espelho literal usa o dispositivo de tópico 'Quanto à', deturpando a função da partícula (を ≠ は). A própria convenção do lote marca objetos como [obj]/(objeto).
findings.current: Quanto à cerveja, quantos copos (você) bebeu?
findings.suggested: Cerveja [obj], quantos copos (você) bebeu?

findings.issue: お金を is a を-marked object, but the literal mirror renders it as topic ('as for money'), misrepresenting を as は — contradicting the expl, which correctly says を marks the object.
findings.current: Every month, a little, as for money, I save (it).
findings.suggested: Every month, a little, money [obj], (I) save.

findings.issue: お金を é objeto marcado por を, mas o espelho literal usa 'quanto a dinheiro' (dispositivo de tópico), deturpando a função da partícula e contradizendo a expl, que diz corretamente que を marca o objeto.
findings.current: Todo mês, um pouco, quanto a dinheiro, (eu) junto.
findings.suggested: Todo mês, um pouco, dinheiro [obj], (eu) junto.

findings.issue: 醤油が is a が-marked subject, but the literal mirror renders it with the topic device 'As for the soy sauce', misrepresenting が as は — contradicting the expl, which correctly identifies が as subject marker.
findings.current: As for the soy sauce, since there's none left, let's buy some.
findings.suggested: Since the soy sauce (subject が) is already gone, let's buy (some).

findings.issue: 醤油が é sujeito marcado por が, mas o espelho literal usa 'Quanto ao shoyu' (dispositivo de tópico), deturpando が como は — contradizendo a expl, que identifica corretamente が como marcador de sujeito.
findings.current: Quanto ao shoyu, como já não existe, vamos comprar.
findings.suggested: Como o shoyu (sujeito が) já não existe, vamos comprar.

findings.issue: 店の入り口で is a locative で phrase, but the literal mirror renders it as topic ('As for the entrance…') and fabricates a resumptive 'there' absent from the Japanese. Misrepresents で, which the expl correctly teaches as place-of-action marker.
findings.current: As for the entrance of the shop, I am waiting there.
findings.suggested: At the store's entrance (で), (I) am waiting.

findings.issue: 店の入り口で é adjunto de lugar com で, mas o espelho literal usa 'Quanto à entrada da loja' (dispositivo de tópico), deturpando a função de で, que a expl ensina corretamente como marcador de lugar da ação.
findings.current: Quanto à entrada da loja, (eu) estou esperando.
findings.suggested: Na entrada da loja (で), (eu) estou esperando.

findings.issue: 薬を é objeto marcado por を, mas o espelho usa 'Quanto a remédio' (tópico), deturpando a partícula; além disso inverte a ordem do japonês (毎日 vem antes de 薬を).
findings.current: Quanto a remédio, todo dia, sem tomar não vira (não dá).
findings.suggested: Todo dia, remédio [obj], sem tomar não vira (não dá).

findings.issue: 薬を is a を-marked object, but the literal mirror renders it with the topic device 'As for the medicine', misrepresenting を as は — contradicting the expl, which correctly says を marks the object.
findings.current: As for the medicine, I take it twice a day.
findings.suggested: Medicine [obj], twice in one day, (I) take.

findings.issue: 薬を é objeto marcado por を, mas o espelho literal usa 'Quanto ao remédio' (dispositivo de tópico), deturpando a função da partícula e contradizendo a expl, que diz corretamente que を marca o objeto.
findings.current: Quanto ao remédio, (eu o) bebo duas vezes em um dia.
findings.suggested: Remédio [obj], duas vezes em um dia, (eu o) bebo.

findings.issue: 割合が is a が-marked subject, but the literal mirror renders it as topic ('As for the proportion…') with a fabricated resumptive 'it', misrepresenting が as は — contradicting the expl, which correctly identifies が as subject marker.
findings.current: As for the proportion of foreigners, it is increasing.
findings.suggested: The proportion of foreigners (subject が) is increasing.

findings.issue: 割合が é sujeito marcado por が, mas o espelho literal usa 'Quanto à proporção…' com retomada 'ela', deturpando が como は — contradizendo a expl, que identifica corretamente が como marcador de sujeito.
findings.current: Quanto à proporção de estrangeiros, ela está aumentando.
findings.suggested: A proporção de estrangeiros (sujeito が) está aumentando.

findings.issue: Note calls まし the 'past form of ます'. まし is the conjunctive (連用形) stem of ます; the past is expressed by the following た token, as that token's own note correctly states. As written the two notes contradict each other.
findings.current: pt-BR: forma passada まし de ます / en: past form まし of ます
findings.suggested: pt-BR: forma conetiva まし de ます (antes de た) / en: conjunctive form まし of ます (before た)

findings.issue: Says the target 'なん + counter + か appears in なんばい (何杯)', implying か is contained in なんばい. か is the sentence-final question particle (explained separately later); the pattern inside なんばい is only なん + counter.
findings.current: The grammatical target なん + counter + か appears in なんばい (何杯)
findings.suggested: The grammatical target なん + counter appears in なんばい (何杯)

findings.issue: Mesmo problema da expl_en: 'なん + contador + か aparece em なんばい' sugere que か está dentro de なんばい. か é a partícula final de pergunta (explicada depois); dentro de なんばい há apenas なん + contador.
findings.current: O alvo gramatical なん + contador + か aparece em なんばい (何杯)
findings.suggested: O alvo gramatical なん + contador aparece em なんばい (何杯)

findings.issue: この部屋は is the topic (the expl teaches the double-subject は…が construction), but lit_en renders it as a locative 'In this room', hiding the topic structure. Inconsistent with lit_pt, which correctly mirrors the topic ('Quanto a este quarto').
findings.current: In this room, the air conditioning is strong.
findings.suggested: As for this room, the air conditioning is strong.

findings.issue: lit_en is identical to the natural 'en' field and does not mirror the Japanese structure at all, while lit_pt does mirror it ('sem tomar não vira'). The pair should be structurally parallel.
findings.current: I have to take medicine every day.
findings.suggested: Every day, medicine [obj], if (I) don't take (it), it won't do.

findings.issue: Gloss 'to have (drink)' fits the beverage sense of 飲む; the context is 薬を飲む = to take medicine. Compare sent:gen-0314332f3d50, which correctly glosses 飲む as 'to take (medicine) / to drink'. The pt gloss ('tomar') is fine.
findings.current: to have (drink)
findings.suggested: to take (medicine)
